request.description: One small complete wall-mounted dungeon torch/brazier, a native pixel-art prop for a whimsical flat FRONT-ELEVATION 2D sidescroller. Transparent background. On this 64x64 canvas keep the actual torch silhouette narrow, about 18 pixels wide and 38 pixels tall, centered with generous transparent margin. A compact black cool-iron bowl with a simple horizontal rim and two lower bands, a short straight bracket and tiny dark wall mounting plate. Flame above bowl has a readable tapering yellow-orange silhouette, one pointed central tongue and one small side tongue, bright pale yellow core, restrained orange edge, at most two tiny ember pixels. Clean chunky connected clusters, very limited shading, no smooth gradients, no glowing haze, no ground shadow, no cast shadow, no floor or walls. Iron has only three cool dark tones with a small restrained warm rim directly beneath the flame. Show the whole flame and mounting. No wood handle, no pole, no ornament, no red-orange stone or full room. Rattlebones style reference governs clean native pixel rendering and economical shading only, not the subject or palette.

Sprites without a background keep their own pixels, centred on the canvas, while the drawn pixel is close to the requested one; coarser or oversized sprites are redrawn. Experimental 16x16 creation always uses image-to-pixel-art. Editing and inpainting start at 32x32 and never use image-to-pixel-art conversion.
